brief: The ultimate guide to deep work — 6 protocols that quadrupled my output.

slots.title: Calendar Your Cognition
slots.body: Treat deep work like an immovable meeting. Block 90-minute windows on your calendar and defend them against all intrusions.
slots.calloutBody: Pre-commitment removes decision fatigue and signals priority to others.

slots.title: Eliminate Distractions
slots.body: Turn off notifications, close irrelevant tabs, and put your phone in another room. Create a vacuum where attention can thrive.
slots.calloutBody: Attention residue from interruptions can cost you twenty minutes of focus.

slots.title: Prime Your Environment
slots.body: Use a consistent pre-work ritual to cue your brain. Same beverage, same seat, same soundtrack—trigger flow on demand.
slots.calloutBody: Classical conditioning builds a neurological shortcut into focused states.

slots.title: Sprint, Then Rest
slots.body: Work in undistracted bursts of fifty minutes followed by ten-minute breaks. Intensity plus recovery beats marathon sessions.
slots.calloutBody: Ultradian rhythms demand oscillation; rest restores glucose and willpower.

slots.title: Quarantine Contexts
slots.body: Batch shallow tasks into isolated windows. Never let email or admin bleed into your deep work sanctuary.
slots.calloutBody: Context switching is the silent killer of cognitive performance.

slots.title: Close The Loop
slots.body: End each day with a shutdown ritual. Review open loops, schedule tomorrow, and mentally clock out completely.
slots.calloutBody: A clean shutdown prevents rumination and protects evening recovery.

slots.body: Pick one protocol and test it tomorrow. Momentum beats perfection when you are rebuilding your focus.
